description: Enhanced boundary coverage for basic schema packaging: ordinal ordering of multiple tables, intra-project view dependency resolution, an empty project with no schema objects, and a non-dbo user schema.

sql_files.Zebra.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Zebra]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)
sql_files.Apple.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Apple]
(
	c1 int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
)

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Apple],[dbo].[Zebra]
views=
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none

sql_files.Customer.sql:
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Customer]
(
	id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
	name nvarchar(100) NULL
)
sql_files.CustomerView.sql:
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[CustomerView]
  AS SELECT id, name FROM [dbo].[Customer]

cases.expected_output:
exit_code=0
package_exists=true
tables=[dbo].[Customer]
views=[dbo].[CustomerView]
pre_deploy_script=false
post_deploy_script=false
diagnostics=none

exit_code=0
